title: canadian dollar weakens nine day low fed rate hike bets 2026 09 11
text:
TORONTO, Sept 11 (Reuters) - The Canadian dollar weakened to a nine-day low against its U.S. counterpart on Friday as U.S. inflation data supported bets ​for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next week.
The loonie was ‌trading 0.2% lower at 1.3862 per U.S. dollar, or 72.14 U.S. cents, after touching its weakest intraday level since September 2 at 1.3883. For the week, the currency was ​down 0.2%.
